_comment: Roles the people and systems of the traveller's journey (user-scenarios/) play, named after this guide's actors (input/fsh/actors/actors.fsh). Schema: cat-harness-tools/schemas/process/role-graph.ts. Every person is fictional; Onesa and Taifafeki are fictional countries (codes XXK and XXR, shared with litlfred/smart-trust-demo scenarios/countries/). The six system roles are the six boxes of each moment's ArchiMate strip.
name: smart-trust

roles.title: Traveller
roles.description: A person from one country who travels to another and carries a verifiable copy of their International Patient Summary. This guide's Holder.

roles.title: Clinic front desk
roles.description: The person at a clinic's reception who registers the patient and receives the verifiable health document they share.

roles.title: Clinician
roles.description: The health worker who reads the verified summary and gives care.

roles.title: Key master representative
roles.description: The person a Trust Network Participant names to submit and manage its public key material on the GDHCN.

roles.title: Onesa PKI (signing)
roles.description: Onesa's Public Key Infrastructure on the signing side: its Country Signing Certificate Authority and the Document Signer Certificates it issues, with the public keys Onesa submits to the GDHCN.

roles.title: GDHCN Trust List
roles.description: The WHO GDHCN Trust Network Gateway and the trust list it distributes: every participant's verified public keys.

roles.title: Taifafeki PKI (verification)
roles.description: Taifafeki's Public Key Infrastructure on the verifying side: the copy of the GDHCN trust list it downloads and keeps for its health systems to verify with.

roles.title: Onesa Issuer (IPS)
roles.description: The Onesan system that assembles the traveller's International Patient Summary and signs it with a Document Signer Certificate, as a Verifiable Health Link (HCERT) or SMART Health Link. This guide's Issuer.

roles.title: Wallet (Traveller)
roles.description: The traveller's health wallet on their phone: it holds the signed summary and shows it as a QR code.

roles.title: Verifier (Clinic)
roles.description: The Taifafeki clinic's system: it scans the QR code, verifies the signature with Onesa's public key from the GDHCN trust list, and shows the summary to the clinician. This guide's Receiver.
